posts.title: 8B LLMs can almost do basic agentic coding
posts.description: At the end of last year , I authored an LLM evaluation that measured a model’s ability to do a simple agentic coding task. The model is placed inside of a typical coding agent harness and asked to carry out a basic refactor that requires the model to make a few tool calls to navigate a repository and make the change.
